name: Mortenax Blade
desc:
His body is like springwood. His heart is like dead ash. Yet still, a craftsman's spark cling to his fingertips.
Ancient grudges flare anew. He vows to send both himself and that God over to the other shore.
This body torn asunder, yet holding fast through a thousand temperings into a blade... What answer will it forge?

stories.0: His body is like springwood. His heart is like dead ash. Yet still, a craftsman's spark cling to his fingertips.\nAncient grudges flare anew. He vows to send both himself and that God over to the other shore.\nThis body torn asunder, yet holding fast through a thousand temperings into a blade... What answer will it forge?
stories.1: He still remembered those early days in the Zhuming, gazing up at the endless shelves of forging manuals, the armory's display of divine weapons stretching out like an endless sea. As a mayfly never sees the night, a cicada knows nothing of spring and autumn. For the first time in his life, he truly understood how small a man could be next to the ages. With the short lifespan of his kind, he'd be lucky to even scratch the surface of the forging art. He could only start from scraps, filling the crumbling smelting furnace with coal slag. He failed. That sword seemed flawless and sharp beyond measure, yet shattered into pieces when he flicked his finger to test it. "A useless blade..."Burning with shame, he hid it away. What he didn't see was his white-haired master running a finger across that broken sword, nor the thin red line of blood it left on his fingertip. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." He remembered the shackles he forged for the Ten-Lords Commission. "Forging a blade is like tempering the soul. The real skill is making the simplest thing well." He didn't understand. If his skills were already exceptional, why did his master make him start from being an apprentice? But he never argued. He believed in the general's words, just as he believed that a true gem never stays buried for long. His fellow disciples came, the Flamewheel Octet came, Huaiyan came. They all watched him, laboring day and night without rest in the Forge. Until the flames finally died out, and they laid eyes on the most fearsome shackles of their lives. The cold gleam of those manacles was muted, but their menace weighed on one like a mountain. No one could have imagined that years later, the imprisoned Borisin Warhead would spend long, long years locked up in chains cut from the same cloth. He remembered the trial for Furnace Master. But for a short-life species to be chosen as the chief craftsman of the Zhuming, that was unprecedented. He'd prepared himself well. But when the smelting began, he found that all his materials had been swapped for rotten scrap. He just smiled. A day and a night later, he unveiled a delicate, ingenious mechanical lion, a creation that put any treasure-forged contraption to shame. He remembered how before being granted the title "Furnace Master," his master repeated that simplest of questions— "What makes a blade?" He'd never once hesitated in his answer. That was the peerless weapon he was meant to forge, the one that would leave every other blade in the dust. Yet when these distant memories resurface, all he could hear was the mournful howls of shattered blades.
stories.2: He joined the Stellaron Hunters to seek the ultimate "salvation"... At least, that's what the Hunters promised. Clink, clank, bullet casings clattered to the ground, like some kind of melody. "Oh no, I'm all out of bullets." The lady raised both hands, eyes darting toward the sky. The night was silent. Then a pillar of light pierced the heavens, hurtling toward the hunters. The madman charged straight into it. The high-energy beam nearly tore him apart. No, clearly not. His flesh was like rampant spring ivy, knitting itself back together in the blink of an eye. "Stop testing my loyalty! If I find out your promises were nothing but lies, I'll be the first to put a blade through you!" "Listen to me, Bladie. As long as you don't want it, no one can make you bleed." The Antimatter Legion before her eyes was torn to shreds by a dark figure. A silver mech punched what few Voidrangers remained into dust, then turned to watch, helpless, as one man danced alone against an army. "Remember, Sam, whatever you do, don't get caught in his sword formation." She recalled Kafka's parting words before the mission. And now, staring at the gruesome wreckage before her, she understood what it meant to be a blade— He was the sharpest "Blade" of the Stellaron Hunters. Clink, clang, the snow came down all night, so thick it nearly buried the camp whole. The silver-haired girl stepped out of her tent and found him still sitting cross-legged, sword laid across his knees. "Get some rest. I'll take watch tonight." "No need. I'm used to it." "Hmph. Weirdo." She watched as snow piled up on his shoulders, as if it had turned his hair white. A deep chill suddenly washed over her. She understood then. There were some people in this world who could only find a moment's peace on these barren, empty snowfields.
stories.3: Chaos. Darkness. The belly of the beast from the dawn of the universe seemed ready to dissolve everything. He'd thought himself numb to pain long ago, but now an invisible struggle threatened to tear his soul to shreds. Petty whispers chattered on and on inside his head, step by step, coaxing him toward the abyss of ruin. "Why resist? I can grant you the power to reforge life and death itself, to undo all your regrets!" Undo all regrets... He thought of Master Huaiyan, the disappointment in his eyes. He thought of the five of them, once so full of promise. He thought of the ending he should have had... No. Not that. Never that. Not once, not ever. This was nothing but escape, cowardice, surrender... Just like those years spent rotting in regret. Just like this aimless, half-dead existence, wandering from day to day with nothing but the wish to die. That wasn't how his "script" was supposed to "end." "Stellaron Hunters exist to rewrite Finality, and to rewrite their own endings." In the "Finality" Elio revealed, he glimpsed a sea of spider lilies scattered with bones, a boundless beast skewered through, and a furnace belching flames. Black hair turned white as snow, and the aged artisan could finally embrace death. Yet the root of the immortality calamity had already bloomed anew elsewhere... He still has a chance to change it all. "Yingxing, are you really so bent on dragging us both into the abyss!? All you'll gain is endless suffering, torn between life and death!" He didn't hear Shuhu's frenzied roar. Instead, he heard his master's voice, his companions' voices, his own voice— "What makes a blade?" He had once forged shackles to cage the mighty foes. Now, he would forge himself into a prison. As a hunter, his sole pursuit had been the elusive release of death. Now, he would take revenge on the architect of this tragedy. He felt himself cracking apart. Piece by piece. Shard by shard. Like snowflakes torn asunder, frozen in an instant by a surge of boundless life, then sent drifting once more into the sea of suffering. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft. Good." With great effort, he raised his hand, just as he had many years ago when he first lifted the forging hammer, striking the white-hot metal until it was sharp enough to plunge that immortal abomination to unending hell. His scorching iron body couldn't shed tears. In his daze, he could almost believe he was still in the Forge, blazing with blinding radiance like a divine weapon fresh from quenching.
stories.4: He thought of that lonely island of Insumousu, bristling with rusted, broken swords. He wanted to go back, just once, to let those sword cries of grief, of hatred, of sorrow, rest in peace, if only for a moment. He thought of his aging master, and the warmth born of longing and shame welled up in his chest. Closing his eyes, he could almost smell the smoke and fire of the Zhuming, hear the endless rhythm of hammers on anvils. "Once this is all over, maybe I could..." He let out a long sigh. Then he turned and walked back to the Hunters' camp. "Mara-struck? He's completely cured... At least he's no longer clamoring to skin that little azure dragon alive." "Oh, right, about that box Blade mentioned, he admitted that the stuff inside was a gift for us!" He gently pushed the door open, frowning: "Do I really need to report matters unrelated to the mission to her as well?" "Bladie, thank you." A woman's voice came through the phone. "No need." "We'll celebrate for you once everyone is back." The man paused, took a few steps, then stopped again. "The item in the iron box is poorly made. If you want, I can make another." "Okay, sure," the young girl looked at him in surprise, "then why don't you tell her yourself? Look, talking to you just made me have to restart again!" He didn't reply, but turned around and headed to the next room. "Practice hard, the next time we PK when your hand is healed, I won't go easy on you." "Okay." He unfastened the Shard Sword and placed it by the bed. In the past, it was resentment, it was fury, it was regret, it was the embodiment of all agony. He stroked the shattered blade. What exactly constitutes a blade? Perhaps a blade is simply a blade, nothing more.

voicelines.voice_m: I remember you, {NICKNAME}. Time has made us both sharper. Yet you are still you... and I am still me.
You're here. ...Have you eaten?
Though our paths have diverged... the bond between us remains unbroken.
A shattered body reforged, tempered through countless deaths. After a thousand trials, a new "Blade" is born.

It gave me an infinite lifespan of suffering, so I will return the favor with an inferno of endless torment. This undying body will be forged a thousand times over, tempered in fury until it turns pitch-black. I will make it understand... the true pain of living.
For me, the hardest part of forging is choosing a name... Such as "Cloud-Piercer" and "Shard Sword"... They've kept me awake through many sleepless nights.
I have no interest in the role of "Supplicant." I'm not here to worship. I'm here to settle the past.
We play our parts in the "script," yet beyond it, we became companions.
The hot springs in Planarcadia are comfortable, but they dull your edge. Bone-chilling cold water on the other hand, that's what helps me relax.
At the moment before death, memories come flooding back... and that hurts more than death itself.

The sword in my hand has shattered twice, true to its name, "Shard Sword." I still remember its first forging. It was nothing more than a failed, broken blade. "Waste not the bounty of the world, but perfect it through craft." By that creed, it was reborn again and again through destruction.
Once, the only thing that kept me alive was death. That part hasn't changed. The difference is... now I understand what I'm willing to die for.
I knew little of you before, until you set foot on another path, one called "Trailblaze."
My hand's healed quite a bit. I should be able to keep my promise and play with her this time. Still, I won't be nearly as skilled with a controller as I am with a sword.
In a final blaze, we parted with the past. Yet where we go from here remains uncertain.
She has done much to suppress the mara. Now that I've broken my shackles, it's time I help her fulfill her wish.
Elio only cares about two things: the cost, and the outcome.
When will he stop hiding behind his role as a general and confront his past?
The wounds she left have long since healed. But the blade I wield will never forget.
The debts Imbibitor Lunae owes... he has repaid many of them. But the past cannot be so easily erased.
She walks beside me in the fight against "immortality."
We once believed miracles would always happen. That's what led to disaster... I hope she's thought through the consequences.
When I was young, he tried to convince me to leave with him and become a ranger. But I chose to stay and forge swords. If I had gone with him... There are no "ifs" in life.
Ever since I left the forge behind and became a hunter, I've felt unworthy to face my master. But when this is over, if I return with what I've forged... maybe I won't let him down.
If the body is to be honed, it must face a thousand blows.
With blazing death, forge this body anew.
Quenched in blood, only then comes rebirth.
Step by step, every grudge will be laid to rest.
Just how long has it been since last time?

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Silver Wolf
voicelines.voice_m: Hmm. This fight doesn't call for your full power.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Silver Wolf LV.<unbreak>999</unbreak>
voicelines.voice_m: So this is your new trick, LV9... Anyway, we'll do it your way.
Those we could not lay to rest now run through our blood and bones.
Rebirth need not wait until the ending is rewritten.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Jing Yuan
voicelines.voice_m: Make sure your Starfall Reverie doesn't lose its edge.
I can withstand the pain of a thousand temperings... you played your part in that.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng
voicelines.voice_m: Nameless Dan Heng, it's been a while.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae
voicelines.voice_m: Beyond outward appearance, you and he are hardly alike.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
voicelines.voice_m: I see... you've taken a new step forward as well.
It appears you have not yet failed.

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Yao Guang
voicelines.voice_m: The criminal stands before you once again, will you not enforce justice?
La Mancha... I have never forgotten the favor you once granted me.
This will be our final meeting.
Good. You'll serve to sharpen my blade.
All scores are settled here.
This journey ends it all.
I will bury you.
A drawn sword knows no rest until death.
Delay much longer, and the sword's intent may turn cold.
Mere iron.
Purgatory... take hold!
Tomb of Blades... Eternal!
Done?
More.
Torn flesh, tempered a thousand times into a blade.
Returned from death a thousandfold...
Burn this broken shell, you will serve as the tempering fire!
Shuhu... I can't...
Is there a chance...?
No need.
The shackles of the past are not broken in a single day.
Alright, it's yours.
Just this, and nothing more.
Hmm. Fine material.
The art of ingenia takes many forms.
Hardly innovative.
Merely another soul among the dead.
If nothing else remains, I should save my strength.

1.name: Ere My Death, I Stood Unmade
1.desc: While the Zone is active, decreases all enemies' All-Type RES by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. After using the extra Skill from Talent, the "Infinite Fury" countdown has its <u>action delayed</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.

10000002.name: Action Delayed
10000002.desc: Increases the target's waiting interval before the next action.

2.name: Ash Was My Heart, Yet the Flame Stayed
2.desc: When an ally character uses Ultimate to deal DMG, it is considered as having launched <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>. And the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> DMG dealt by ally targets increases by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>. The upper limit of Mortenax Blade's Charge decreases to <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

3.name: Across the Shore, Wrath Laid Bare
3.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nTalent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.

4.name: Odium I've Smitten, Thence Came the Blade
4.desc: "Heart, Refined ad Infinitum" additionally increases ally targets' DMG dealt by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak>.

5.name: I Severed My Woes, Knowing Death Begets Life
5.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>15</unbreak>.\nBasic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. <unbreak>10</unbreak>.

6.name: If Immortality Could Die, I Swore THEM Slain
6.desc: As the Zone persists, when Mortenax Blade takes DMG or consumes HP, he gains 1 Charge. This effect can trigger again after any target's turn ends. The DMG multiplier of "Tenax Per Ignem" increases to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of its original value.

150701.name: A Broken Blade Still Slays
150701.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.
150701.simple_desc: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy and inflicts the Taunt state on the target.

150702.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate
150702.desc:
Consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP and deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies, and additionally deals <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one random enemy.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses Skill.
While not in the "Infinite Fury" state or when the current HP is 1 or lower, Mortenax Blade cannot use his Skill.
Using Skill does not consume Skill Points.
150702.simple_desc: Consumes HP and deals Fire DMG to all enemies. Then, deals minor Fire DMG to single enemies, bouncing <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> time(s).

150703.name: Fornax Ex Corpore
150703.desc:
Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies. Enemy targets in the "Balefire Bind" state have their DEF reduced by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[f1]%</unbreak></color> and the DMG they receive increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color>, lasting for <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> turn(s). Then, consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to deploy a Zone. While the Zone is active, Mortenax Blade enters the "Infinite Fury" state.
During the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>, increases CRIT DMG by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[f1]%</unbreak></color>, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a new Ultimate "Tenax Per Ignem." When receiving a killing blow, this unit will not be <u>knocked down</u>, but will dispel the Zone, exit the "Infinite Fury" state, and restore HP equal to <unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak> of this unit's Max HP.
When gaining the "Infinite Fury" state, a corresponding countdown appears on the Action Order. The countdown has a fixed SPD of <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>. At the start of the countdown's turn, dispels the Zone and exits the "Infinite Fury" state.
If the current HP is insufficient, Mortenax Blade's current HP will be reduced to 1 when he uses this ability.
150703.simple_desc: Inflicts "Balefire Bind" on all enemies, causing the targets to <color=#f29e38ff>decrease their DEF and increase the DMG they receive</color>. Then, consumes this unit's HP to activate a Zone. While the Zone is active, this unit gains the "Infinite Fury" state, increases CRIT Rate, increases CRIT DMG, enhances Basic ATK, unlocks Skill, and gains a <color=#f29e38ff>new Ultimate</color>, lasting until the countdown ends.\nWhen Mortenax Blade receives a killing blow, the Zone is dispelled.

10000007.name: Downed State
10000007.desc: An ally will be incapacitated once their HP is reduced to 0.

150704.name: All Karma Comes Due
150704.desc: While the Zone is active, after each attack an ally target uses on an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the corresponding enemy target and grants 1 Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> points and the current HP is more than 1, consumes <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Charge, regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f1]</unbreak></color> Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use Skill 1 extra time. This extra Skill use is considered as <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>.
150704.simple_desc: While the Zone is active, after an ally target attacks an enemy, inflicts the "Balefire Bind" state on the enemy and grants Charge to Mortenax Blade. When Charge reaches <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> points and his HP is higher than 1, consumes <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> Charge to regenerate Energy, and enables Mortenax Blade to use his <color=#f29e38ff>Skill</color> 1 <color=#f29e38ff>extra time</color>.

10000004.name: Follow-Up ATK
10000004.desc: Unleashes an extra attack on the target. This effect is triggered automatically when requirements are met.

150706.name: One Cut Ends All
150706.desc: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.

150707.name: Blade's Reach Spares None
150707.desc: Immediately attacks all enemies within a certain range. After entering combat, inflicts the Taunt state on all enemies for 1 turn and decreases DMG taken by this unit by <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> for <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> turn(s).
150707.simple_desc: Attacks all enemies within range. After entering combat, inflicts the Taunt state on all enemies and reduces DMG taken by this unit.

150708.name: A Tempered Blade Severs Souls
150708.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to one designated enemy, and causes the target to enter the Taunt state for 1 turn.
150708.simple_desc: Deals Fire DMG to one enemy and inflicts the Taunt state on the target.

150709.name: A Rain of Blades Seals Fate

150714.name: Tenax Per Ignem
150714.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Mortenax Blade's Max HP to all enemies.
150714.simple_desc: Deals massive Fire DMG to all enemies.
